dedupe_keys.name: arcep new deal mobile dashboard data 2018 2022 discontinued

description: This dataset holds the data of Arcep's dashboard of the New Deal mobile, the 2018 agreement under which French mobile operators committed to accelerate coverage of rural areas in exchange for licence renewals. It gives quarterly lists of mobile sites in metropolitan France with their technologies and the 4G coverage indicators for each operator, including the targeted coverage scheme sites and the switch of all sites to 4G. Coverage: metropolitan France, site and national level, quarterly from April 2018 to March 2022. Format and access: CSV and XLSX files (about 35 files, 164 MB) on data.gouv.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Caveats: no longer updated; Arcep points to the Mon Réseau Mobile open data, where site files continue in the same format and the indicators can be rebuilt. Simulation uses: a historical series of mobile site roll-out for planning studies and for evaluating coverage policy. Related records: Arcep Mon Réseau Mobile continues these data, and ANFR radio installations give site equipment.
